cells.gaps: No regulation or decree applying the law, and no rule made under it that others must check identity against the system, dated in the last three years, is held. The regulations of 23 July 2026 change fees, which do not count.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-10-31: The 2010 Act is called the legal foundation of the digital identity system (MWI-005); the July 2026 regulations change fees only, which the ladder excludes. Stage 4 holds.
